title: Menschen und Technik – Ein handlungsorientiertes Beschreibungsmodell der Technikkommunikation
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: Technical communication is currently undergoing profound change, bringing with it a range of challenges. Growing complexity, increasingly diverse audiences, interdisciplinary modes of collaboration, and ongoing digital transformation demand new approaches. Existing models and terminology often fall short when it comes to capturing the realities of contemporary technical communication. In response, Franziska Heidrich-Wilhelms proposes an action-oriented descriptive model as an integrative analytical framework. Drawing on insights from linguistics, specialized communication studies, visual communication, media studies, and related disciplines, she brings these perspectives together within a coherent and systematic structure. At the heart of the model are four core dimensions: people, information products, processes, and artefacts. By introducing this new perspective, the volume provides both a theoretically grounded and practice-oriented framework for analysing and designing professional technical communication.
